cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.31% · WTI +0.34% · Brent +0.03% · NatGas +1.73%. At the last close, 58% of 67 energy names were green — a broad bid. Nuclear & Uranium did the heavy lifting at +4.94%.

cards.headline: Nuclear & Uranium leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Nuclear & Uranium at +4.94%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -1.02%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: OKLO is the standout at +22.66%
cards.body: Leaders: OKLO +22.66%, LEU +17.49%, VST +10.55%, ARRY +10.47%, NRG +9.61%. Laggards: EOSE -7.45%, TRGP -2.66%, EQT -2.41%, DUK -1.77%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
